title: E-commerce 360° Sales Engine
summary: A 9-point strategic overhaul to maximize conversion, retention, and organic reach.
description: I executed a full-funnel audit and optimization plan for a Shopify-based brand, focusing on technical speed, user psychology, and automated marketing loops.

grid_modules.title: 01. Speed Optimization
grid_modules.details: High bounce rates were caused by heavy assets. I implemented image lazy-loading, script minification, and app-weight reduction.

grid_modules.title: 02. Shopify 2.0 Arch
grid_modules.details: Migrated the store to Shopify Online Store 2.0. This allows for modular sections on every page, making the site faster to navigate.

grid_modules.title: 03. Custom Liquid UX
grid_modules.details: Built custom Liquid sections to provide a 'Beautiful Layout' aesthetic while maintaining maximum site speed without PageFly bloat.

grid_modules.title: 04. 30-Day Retention
grid_modules.details: Developed an automated '30-day reorder' email sequence, creating a predictable revenue stream from repeat customers.

grid_modules.title: 05. Mobile UX Overhaul
grid_modules.details: Restructured vertical hierarchy to move high-intent CTAs higher, drastically reducing the need to scroll to find products.

grid_modules.title: 06. Social Proof Engine
grid_modules.details: Implemented a site-wide customer review system. Social proof is the primary driver for conversion with first-time visitors.

grid_modules.title: 07. Modash Influencers
grid_modules.details: Identified and onboarded niche creators using Modash to provide a steady stream of pre-warmed, high-intent traffic.

grid_modules.title: 08. Omnisend (SD)
grid_modules.details: Built a comprehensive Omnisend strategy for SD, focusing on segmented campaigns to drive repeat customer traffic.

grid_modules.title: 09. SEO Mastery
grid_modules.details: Deep keyword research and on-page optimization to capture high-intent traffic and reduce reliance on paid ads.
